synopsis: DEMIRS is identified as Western Australia's mines regulator, previously named DMIRS [f15546, f15547]. The regulator followed up autonomous-truck collisions at Fortescue and BHP sites in 2019 [f15546]. Chapter 3 and the glossary both state that the booklet did not verify the regulator's codes, leaving a gap in its coverage of rules and acceptance criteria [f2269, f15547].

relations.note: Both identify the same gap: WA mines regulator codes were not verified.
